instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a slightly high angle captures an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and a ceiling-mounted projector. In the center-left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, leaning forward with her right arm extended to touch the right shoulder of the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing forward with a neutral expression. The room is illuminated by even overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows.
